description: Stop messages that are still waiting to be sent (as listed by list_scheduled_activity): either ONE row (pass source + source_id; it is cancelled immediately — stopping a send needs no approval) or ALL rows matching optional filters (pass all=true; this needs the user's confirmation — call first with confirm=false to get the count, then confirm=true). Pending store notifications (Salla / Zid / WooCommerce) are deleted; queued WhatsApp messages are marked cancelled and never sent. Already-sent messages are not affected and cannot be recalled. Does NOT stop bulk campaigns (use cancel_campaign).

all.description: true = cancel EVERY pending row matching the filters below (all sources when no filter). Requires confirm.

confirm.description: For all=true: pass false first to get the count and a breakdown (nothing is cancelled), show it to the user, then true to cancel. Cancelling ONE row (source + source_id) needs no approval and happens immediately whatever this value is — it can only stop a send.

date_from.description: Only rows created on/after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Only rows created on/before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

phone.description: Only rows whose recipient phone STARTS with this (digits, e.g. "9665").

source.description: Source of the ONE row to cancel (from list_scheduled_activity).

source_id.description: source_id of the ONE row to cancel (from list_scheduled_activity).

sources.description: Limit to these sources; omit for all. salla.notification / zid.notification / woo.notification = pending store notifications; message_queue = outgoing WhatsApp send queue.

name: cancel_scheduled_activity
